title: Environment energies of proton transfer in thirteen acid–base crystals: data and code
description: Inputs, outputs, analysis code and figure scripts of a study of thirteen acid-base crystals (nine salts, four cocrystals) and a polymorph pair: the proton-transfer energy of the acid-base pair alone, in the lattice field, with its first hydrogen-bonded shell and in the periodic crystal (PBE0 with MP2, SCS-MP2 and wB97X-D3(BJ) pair corrections), the environment term, error budgets, reverse vertical gaps and the periodic closure. Includes the plan as committed before the production calculations.
